<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/devices/{device_id}/orders"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Sends a list of commands for execution on the specified device.
Each command can be one of the supported types, such as:
(**Add Wi-Fi**, **Delete Wi-Fi**, **Device state**, **Request image**, **Request video**, **Reboot**,
**Periodic**, **Vision configuration**, **Data plan configuration**, **Configure audio**, **Configure audio event**).
